# Ashwin Gupta

> AI Systems Engineer based in Bangalore, India. Current employment: AI Engineer at SkanAI, June 2026–present.

This portfolio describes production AI systems, inference routing, concurrency architecture, retrieval-augmented generation, and physics-informed machine learning. Case studies distinguish delivered work from systems in development.

## Profile
- [Ashwin Gupta](https://www.ashwingupta.dev/): Authoritative profile, experience, impact, and contact information. Section URLs such as /about and /projects are entry points into this same document.

## Work
- [HSBC conversational analytics](https://www.ashwingupta.dev/work/hsbc): Voice infrastructure, concurrency, observability, and cost engineering.
- [PageIndexOllama](https://www.ashwingupta.dev/work/pageindexollama): Local-first tree-based retrieval and provider abstraction.
- [Portfolio engineering](https://www.ashwingupta.dev/work/ashwingupta-dev): Interface architecture and performance engineering.
- [Azure infrastructure documentation](https://www.ashwingupta.dev/work/azure-infra-docs): Documentation grounded in live infrastructure inventory.
- [Here.app](https://www.ashwingupta.dev/work/here-app): Multilingual vehicle intelligence and grounded retrieval.
- [Skill recommendation engine](https://www.ashwingupta.dev/work/skill-recommendation-engine): Graph-based recommendations and low-latency inference.

## Research and experimental systems
- [Controla](https://www.ashwingupta.dev/research/controla): Local inference routing with contextual weight learning; in development.
- [ScholarOS](https://www.ashwingupta.dev/research/scholaros): Evidence-bound research execution; in development.
- [Physics-informed neural networks](https://www.ashwingupta.dev/research/pinns): Dual-loss framework, benchmarks, and publication references.
- [PHYSCLIP](https://www.ashwingupta.dev/research/physclip): Contrastive physics regime classification.
